notes.title: Update Notes for 07-21-2024
notes.content:
[b][color=green][u]Winches![/u][/color][/b]  [i]10 vehicles have winches installed.[/i]  Press Z or D-Pad Down to start winching and select attach points.  Press G / D-Pad Up to operate winch.  Press H or Right Thumbstick In to detach.  There’s a new type of junk car found around the map to recover.  You can also attach to some trees.  Currently a mouse is needed to select the attach points, but all other operations can be done with the game pad.

[b]Controller update:[/b] Press Left Thumbstick In if your vehicle gets stuck.  It will move the vehicle up and over 1 meter at a time.  Backspace on the keyboard still does the same.

[b]Trash dump locations:[/b] There are now 3 places to drag trash and abandoned camper trailers: Gamblertown, Sand Dunes Mechanic, and FOB Taproom.  Drag the trash into the cone zone and receive 25 shiny stickers

[b]Training map update:[/b] The Miata now has a winch and can drag a trashed car 

[i]Update to adjust various vehicle handling.  Junk cars and campers no longer need to be “trailer” towed, but can be dragged by a winch.  [/i]

notes.title: Update notes for 07-18-2024.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036561/40c00e295425fb6688113df34b364e61bb67e044.png[/img][i]Hotfix: fixed an issue that prevented NPC dialog triggering too far away from the player and hats not appearing after exiting a vehicle[/i]

[b]New mission type[/b]: Trailers! The “Joop” Cherokee has been fitted with a trailer hitch and can tow junk camper trailers to Gamblertown for a reward.  Tip: don’t ram into the trailer when hitching it up :)

[b]Weather[/b]: random weather changes will happen over time. Rain, clouds, and sunshine will change at random intervals.

[b]UI update[/b]: early starter vehicles have instructions for starting the engine upon entering, and the “Joop” has instructions for attaching the trailer when close enough to tow it.

[i]Sasquatch has been spotted![/i]

Vehicle Gamepad control update from earlier:  
Right trigger = gas
left trigger = brake
Right bumper = fire vehicle weapon (if available)
Left bumper = Handbrake
[color=green][b]A[/b][/color] = start engine
[color=red][b]B[/b][/color] = enter / exit vehicle

Player Gamepad control update:
[color=blue][b]X[/b][/color] = use equipped item (bandage)

[b]Vehicles update[/b]: Vehicles now spawn with engine off.  Press F or Gamepad [b][color=green]A[/color][/b] to start engine.  Vehicles will now move more smoothly and resist flipping over.  Vehicles start with engines off to save cpu resources calculating physics

notes.title: Update notes 07-16-2024.1
notes.content:
[b]Performance update[/b]: NPC models have been simplified or replaced to improve performance.  Previous character models had complex hair and skeletons that were bogging the game down.  AMD FidelityFX has been added to improve FPS on all video cards.

[b]Enemy update[/b]: Enemy AI has been improved to include an alert system.  Litterbugs will spot you and take a moment to decide if you’re a threat.  If you leave or hide, they will ignore you.  If alerted, they will chase.  If they lose sight, they will go to your last seen location and look around.

[b]Quests system[/b]: Quest progress is now saved.  When you reach a checkpoint sign, your location, inventory, and quest progress is saved.  Dialog is now triggered by the NPC and not location based.  Close-up camera shots have been removed until future updates with face/mouth animation.  There are some camera / UI bugs still being worked out

[i]Sasquatch has been spotted![/i]

Vehicle Gamepad control update from earlier:
[*]Right trigger = gas
[*]left trigger = brake
[*]Right bumper = fire vehicle weapon (if available)
[*]Left bumper = Handbrake
[*][color=blue]A[/color] = start engine
[*][color=red][/color]B = enter / exit vehicle
[*][color=yellow]Y[/color] = get unstuck.
[*][color=red]B[/color] = exit vehicle

Player Gamepad control update:
[*]X = use equipped item (bandage)

[b]Vehicles update[/b]: Vehicles now spawn with engine off.  Press F or Gamepad A to start engine.  Vehicles will now move more smoothly and resist flipping over.  Vehicles start with engines off to save cpu resources calculating physics

notes.title: Update Notes for 07-04-2024.1
notes.content:
4th of July update:  Fireworks!  If you go near the stage in Gamblertown, you will find a concrete pad with assorted fireworks.  Go near it and the sky will turn to night.  Press F to light them and enjoy the show!

New spitting litterbug:  Previous bugs only did melee attacks, now watch our for short range poison goo!  Talk to "Geo" after the covered bridge for the earliest encounter.

New garages: go near a garage at a race track to spawn a variety of vehicles.

Track timers: race tracks now start the clock when you pass the green flag, and end at the checkered flag.

New Randle WA HooptieX track:  Access through the cult camp near the open sand dunes.  This track was recreated using satellite imagery from last year's real-world race track

Fix enemy ai navigation bug
